hero.title: A platform connecting you with verified suppliers, your strategic partner in the world of trade and brokerage
hero.description: We offer innovative solutions to connect merchants and investors. Let suppliers compete for your request and choose the most suitable offer with ease and complete safety.
hero.verified_desc: Official documents and trade licenses have been verified for 98% of active suppliers.

services.title: Get the best price quote for any product within minutes
services.description: Our platform allows buyers and suppliers to interact directly and transparently to ensure win-win business deals for both parties.

how.title: How the Platform Works
how.subtitle: An integrated enterprise experience that ensures transparency and speed in executing commercial deals.

step_1.title: Send Your Request
step_1.desc: Specify product details and quantity required accurately through our easy RFQ form.

step_2.title: Merchants Receive the Request
step_2.desc: Our smart algorithms instantly route your request to verified suppliers in the selected category.

step_3.title: Receive Price Quotes
step_3.desc: Suppliers start sending competitive offers directly to your platform dashboard.

step_4.title: Choose the Suitable Offer
step_4.desc: Compare the technical and financial offers and choose the most suitable commercial partner.

platform.why_description: We offer you an integrated and innovative platform to manage all procurement processes with reliability, speed, and high efficiency, ensuring the best results for your business.

procurement.title: Procurement Management
procurement.desc: Create and track purchase requests easily with an integrated system for managing tenders with the highest efficiency.

security.title: Security & Reliability
security.desc: A secure and encrypted system with the latest technologies to protect your data and business transactions from any risks.

suppliers.title: Trusted Suppliers Network
suppliers.desc: Connect with the best certified and trusted suppliers across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

speed.title: Speed of Execution
speed.desc: Get price quotes in record time and select the best one for your project with a single click.

partners.title: We are proud of our clients' trust

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the most common questions

q1.q: How can I create a purchase request?
q1.a: Create your account, then add product details and the required quantity from the request form.

q2.q: Is registration on the platform free?
q2.a: Yes, registration is free and there are no hidden fees for creating an account.

q3.a: The request details reach certified suppliers, and you can compare their offers and choose the most suitable one.

q4.q: Are my data and transactions secure?
q4.a: We use appropriate security and encryption measures to protect your data and business transactions.
